FaqsComp.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
FaqsComp.subheading: Everything you need to know about MSG91 WhatsApp Chat Window.

faqs.question: What is MSG91 WhatsApp Chat Window?
faqs.answer: MSG91 WhatsApp Chat Window is a dedicated customer conversation platform that lets businesses move ongoing WhatsApp conversations into a persistent chat window — enabling AI chatbots, flow bots, human agents, and voice AI to handle queries without relying solely on WhatsApp messages.

faqs.question: How does the Chat Window help reduce WhatsApp messaging costs?
faqs.answer: Once a conversation is initiated on WhatsApp, MSG91 shifts it to the Chat Window for all subsequent exchanges. This means customers and agents can continue communicating without triggering additional per-message charges on WhatsApp, reducing your overall messaging bill significantly.

faqs.question: Do customers need to download an app to use the Chat Window?
faqs.answer: No. The MSG91 Chat Window is web-based and accessible directly through a link sent on WhatsApp. Customers can open it in any mobile browser or desktop browser — no app download required.

faqs.question: What types of automation does the Chat Window support?
faqs.answer: The Chat Window supports AI chatbots for instant FAQ resolution, flow bots for guided conversation journeys, and voice AI for call-to-chat transitions. You can configure automation rules, triggers, and escalation paths from within the MSG91 dashboard.

faqs.question: How does the conversation shift from WhatsApp to the Chat Window?
faqs.answer: When a customer messages on WhatsApp, MSG91 sends a contextual link that opens the Chat Window. The conversation history and context are preserved, so the customer can continue seamlessly without repeating themselves.

faqs.question: Can human agents and AI work together in the same conversation?
faqs.answer: Yes. MSG91 Chat Window supports hybrid workflows where the AI handles initial queries and either escalates to a human agent based on intent or routes the conversation automatically. Agents have full visibility of the prior chat history.

faqs.question: Is MSG91 Chat Window secure and compliant?
faqs.answer: MSG91 follows industry-standard security practices including data encryption in transit and at rest, role-based access controls, and complies with applicable data protection regulations. Enterprise security and compliance documentation is available on request.

faqs.question: How do I get started with MSG91 WhatsApp Chat Window?
faqs.answer: Click the 'Get Started' button on this page to create your MSG91 account. The onboarding wizard will walk you through connecting your WhatsApp Business number, configuring the Chat Window, and setting up your first automation flow — typically in under 30 minutes.
